links.outcome: Format failures and repeatability of LLM scoring across model sizes
links.effect: Standard open-weight models showed 11-fold greater mean absolute bias, more format failures, and lower repeatability than frontier models in Study 1.
links.quote: However, the standard open-weight models tested achieve only about three-quarters of frontier convergent validity, with 11-fold greater mean absolute bias, more format failures, and lower repeatability in Study 1.

unlisted_practices: Discriminant validity testing against related constructs when validating LLM scoring of psychological interviews
Minimum validation standard across five domains for LLM-based psychological assessment

screen.reason: Empirical benchmarking study evaluating convergent and discriminant validity across various LLMs scoring psychological clinical interview data.
